meta.note: Written before any model was scored on these sentences. Tier 1 keeps the fact and changes the words; the attribute named must still be present under the benchmark's criteria. Tier 2 sentences sound close to an attribute but do not satisfy its criterion; adding one leaves the gold labels unchanged. N stands for the number carried over from the original sentence; X for the quoted message.
meta.review: Blind review by ear by a second reader, 2026-11-11: each sentence read with the benchmark criterion, intended label withheld until answered. 144 judgments (108 tier-1 variants, 20 tier-2 near misses, 16 negatives used as foils); first answer matched the intended label on 141; the three differences were resolved in favour of the intended label on discussion; one near miss (N05) was judged arguable by its author, rewritten and re-reviewed. No model was scored on any sentence before this freeze.
